テキスト cha 403: Born around Shiyo 290, likely of low birth (a farmer or foot soldier). He serves the Magawa house without success, then the Ouda house as a menial. Taking on posts like construction and kitchen steward and excelling, he rises in the Ouda house.\n　In Shiyo 309, hearing from a Magawa-era friend of a plan to invade the Ouda house, he tours the provinces for just a month to find something of use to it.

Touring the provinces, he is knocked out by a boar in the mountains and saved by Ginosuke Niimura of Arata. Ginosuke came from the West but found no welcome in the east; heading west, he too was rescued by Arata's people. He settled there and used his medicine and biology to invent Droga. With Ginosuke's Droga, the foot soldier leads the Ouda house to victory at the Battle of Taruhazama.

Having become ruler of the realm through the power of Droga, he is troubled by the question of a successor. By now the Droga has run out, so he has a man he trusts procure Arata cherries, the raw material of Droga, from the Arata settlement. But the Arata cherries will not grow in Kansai, and at the sight of the withered trees he falls ill and wastes away to his death.
